social_profile_lookup.name: social_profile_lookup
social_profile_lookup.using: "profiles"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or "profiles"."username" is not null

social_staff_audit_insert.name: social_staff_audit_insert
social_staff_audit_insert.withCheck:
"audit_log"."actor_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and exists
      (select 1 from profiles where id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
       and role in ('admin','owner') and not suspended)

conversation_participant_select.name: conversation_participant_select
conversation_participant_select.using: participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

conversation_participant_insert.name: conversation_participant_insert
conversation_participant_insert.withCheck: participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

conversation_participant_update.name: conversation_participant_update
conversation_participant_update.using: participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
conversation_participant_update.withCheck: participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')

message_participant_read.name: message_participant_read
message_participant_read.using: exists (select 1 from conversations c where c.id = conversation_id and (c.participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or c.participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')))

message_sender_insert.name: message_sender_insert
message_sender_insert.withCheck:
"direct_messages"."sender_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and exists (select 1 from conversations c where c.id = conversation_id and (c.participant_a = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or c.participant_b = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')))
    and not exists (select 1 from conversations c join user_blocks b on
      (b.blocker_id=c.participant_a and b.blocked_id=c.participant_b) or
      (b.blocker_id=c.participant_b and b.blocked_id=c.participant_a)
      where c.id=conversation_id)

notification_event_insert.name: notification_event_insert
notification_event_insert.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from profiles where id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and role in ('admin','owner') and not suspended) or
    ("notifications"."kind"='message' and exists (
      select 1 from direct_messages m join conversations c on c.id=m.conversation_id
      where m.id="notifications"."message_id" and c.id="notifications"."conversation_id" and m.sender_id=nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')
      and "notifications"."user_id"<>nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and ("notifications"."user_id"=c.participant_a or "notifications"."user_id"=c.participant_b)))

user_report_author_or_staff_read.name: user_report_author_or_staff_read
user_report_author_or_staff_read.using: "user_reports"."reporter_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') or exists (select 1 from profiles where id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and role in ('admin','owner') and not suspended)

user_report_staff_review.name: user_report_staff_review
user_report_staff_review.using: exists (select 1 from profiles where id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and role in ('admin','owner') and not suspended)
user_report_staff_review.withCheck: exists (select 1 from profiles where id = nullif(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '') and role in ('admin','owner') and not suspended)
